text:
maria: quick flag — ChromaHealth account trending down on DAU, onboarding steps incomplete, customer mentioned 'thinking about moving to a smaller plan' in the renewal convo earlier. tagging @oliver @sara for quick triage :eyes:

oliver: saw their usage graph. agree we should try a short, low-friction save play. options: 1) 2-week trial extension + 1:1 enablement 2) temporary metered tier (no commit) 3) targeted fixes to webhook onboarding. which do we want to push first?

sara: technical note — their webhook error count is high (see logs). root cause likely bad callback URL during onboarding. if we do an enablement session we can fix this in <15m. also can enable sample payloads so they see value quickly.

mike: +1 on quick wins. recommend this concrete play: 1) outreach + 30m remediation call 2) enable trial extension 3) apply 20% credit for 2 weeks (fast approval from me) 4) schedule 14-day check-in. call it "Pause & Coach".

emma: approved. please include a short, empathetic outreach script we can send from CSM. keep it simple and offer concrete next steps.

maria: drafting outreach copy below — feedback welcome:

"Hi <Name>,
We noticed your team hasn't completed a few onboarding steps and usage is lower than expected. We'd love to help get you back to value quickly. Can we book a 30-minute troubleshooting + enablement session? We can also put you on a temporary metered tier and extend your trial for 2 weeks while we address any integration issues. No commitment needed.

If that works, what times this week look good? — Maria"

oliver: looks good. tiny edits: call the trial extension a "timeboxed trial" and add a line about a follow-up plan if they re-engage (re-onboard + proactive health check at day 14). also set a metric goal: increase API calls by 50% or reach 5 active users.

sara: posting the quick remediation checklist we can run during the 30m call — please use in the session:

```
1. Confirm webhook URL & resend test payload
2. Verify API key scope & environment (prod vs sandbox)
3. Walk through sample flow: create -> embed -> rerank
4. Enable sample telemetry for 48h
5. Share 2 tactical prompts they can reuse
```

mike: I'll create the temporary credit in billing and note the case ID. maria — ping me when the call is scheduled and I'll attach the credit.

luna-bot: reminder: create "save plan" record in Gainsight for ChromaHealth and set 14-day follow-up. (automated) :robot_face:

maria: next steps for me: 1) send outreach by EOD 2) book remediation slot (sharing calendar) 3) run checklist during call 4) set 14-day health check and measure API calls / DAU. assigning owner: maria (CSM).

emma: great. after the 14-day check if we still see risk we escalate to AM for a renewal proposal that includes a flexible downgrade path (metered tranche + auto-reactivation). otherwise we call this closed.

mike: saved notes in the account — case# CH-5372. tagging @oliver for metric dashboard updates.

maria: thanks everyone — will post update after the call. :thumbsup:
